methodology.Fees: The total trading fees paid by users, excluding L1 transaction fees
methodology.Revenue: A fixed ADA cost per transaction that is collected by the protocol
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: A percentage cut of the fixed ADA cost per transaction that is collected by the protocol
methodology.HoldersRevenue: A percentage cut of the fixed ADA cost per transaction that is going to holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: A percentage cut on all trading volume, paid to Liquidity Providers

Fees.LP Fees: A percentage cut on all trading volume, paid to Liquidity Providers
Fees.Protocol Fees: A fixed ADA cost per transaction that is collected by the protocol

methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees — all fees come from end-users.
methodology.Fees: All fees paid by users: AMM trading fee + batcher execution fee.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol-captured revenue: fee_sharing (to MIN stakers) + batcher fee (to treasury).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Batcher execution fee collected by the protocol treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fee-sharing portion of the AMM trading fee distributed to MIN stakers.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LP fee portion of the AMM trading fee distributed to liquidity providers.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: LP fee portion of the AMM trading fee distributed to liquidity providers.

Revenue.Staking Rewards: Fee-sharing portion of the AMM trading fee distributed to MIN stakers.
Revenue.Service Fees: Batcher execution fee collected by the protocol treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Staking Rewards: Fee-sharing portion of the AMM trading fee distributed to MIN stakers.

ProtocolRevenue.Service Fees: Batcher execution fee collected by the protocol treasury.

methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees - the swap fee is paid by the trader.
methodology.Fees: The swap fee traders pay to liquidity providers - about 0.30% on standard pools and 0.05% on stableswap pools. Excludes the ~2 ADA per-order agent fee, which only reimburses batcher operators for the Cardano network transaction cost.
methodology.Revenue: Zero here. WingRiders separately keeps a small protocol fee (about 0.05% on standard pools) plus optional project and reserve fees that accrue to on-chain treasuries, but those amounts are not published by the public data feed this adapter reads, so protocol revenue is not currently captured.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: All of the reported swap fee, which is paid back into the pools and earned by liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Total value swapped across all WingRiders V1, V2 and stableswap pools over the trailing 24 hours, counted once per trade and valued in ADA.

Fees.Swap Fees: Liquidity-provider swap fee charged on every trade, summed across all pools and valued in ADA.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: The swap fee is paid back into the pool reserves, so liquidity providers earn all of it.

methodology.Fees: Gross value received by the FluidTokens treasury-only fee address, sourced from the FluidTokens daily fees endpoint and denominated in ADA.
methodology.Revenue: All value received by the treasury-only FluidTokens fee address is treated as protocol revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Because the tracked address is treasury-only, all recorded revenue is classified as protocol treasury revenue.

methodology.Fees: CDP fees paid by users (mint fees, interest payments, and redemption fees), collected by the Treasury and INDY stakers. Excludes liquidated collateral, which is distributed to Stability Pool depositors rather than paid to the protocol.
methodology.Revenue: CDP fees collected by the Treasury and distributed to INDY stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: CDP fees captured by the Indigo Treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: CDP fees distributed to INDY stakers.

methodology.Fees: Total fees generated by the protocol: interest accrued by borrowers, loan origination fees, liquidation bonuses and ADA staking rewards earned on assets held in the markets.
methodology.Revenue: Portion of fees kept by the protocol, split between the Liqwid DAO treasury and LQ stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Portion of fees allocated to the Liqwid DAO treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Portion of fees distributed to lenders supplying assets to the markets.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Portion of fees distributed to LQ stakers.

Fees.Borrow Interest: Interest accrued by borrowers across all Liqwid markets.
Fees.Origination Fees: Upfront fees charged to borrowers when loans are originated.
Fees.Liquidation Fees: Liquidation bonuses paid by borrowers whose positions are liquidated.
Fees.Staking Rewards: ADA staking rewards earned on ADA supplied to the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: Share of borrow interest distributed to lenders.
SupplySideRevenue.Staking Rewards: ADA staking rewards distributed to ADA suppliers.

Revenue.Borrow Interest: Share of borrow interest kept by the DAO treasury and distributed to LQ stakers.
Revenue.Origination Fees: Share of loan origination fees kept by the DAO treasury and distributed to LQ stakers.

ProtocolRevenue.Borrow Interest: Share of borrow interest allocated to the Liqwid DAO treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Origination Fees: Share of loan origination fees allocated to the Liqwid DAO treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Borrow Interest: Share of borrow interest distributed to LQ stakers.
HoldersRevenue.Origination Fees: Share of loan origination fees distributed to LQ stakers.

methodology.Fees: Trading and listing fees paid by users.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

methodology.UserFees: 2% marketplace fee paid by sellers on each NFT sale.
methodology.Fees: 2% marketplace fee collected at the jpg.store v3 marketplace contract on each NFT sale.
methodology.Revenue: All marketplace fees collected by the jpg.store protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All marketplace fees collected by the jpg.store protocol.

methodology.Fees: All betting fees (4% of total protocol volume) paid by users.
methodology.Revenue: All betting fees (4% of total protocol volume) paid by users.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: All revenue distributed to BODEGA holders (75%) before Jun 12, 2025 and 100% after Jun 12, 2025.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: No revenue for Bodega protocol after Jun 12, 2025 and 25% before Jun 12, 2025.

methodology.Fees: All trading fees collected by the platform.
methodology.Revenue: All trading fees collected by the platform.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 100% of all trading fees collected by the platform goes to $STRIKE holders.

Fees.Trading Fees: Fees collected from trades executed on the Strike Finance.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Fees collected from trades executed on the Strike Finance.

HoldersRevenue.Trading Fees: 100% of all trading fees collected by the platform goes to $STRIKE holders.

methodology.Volume: USD value of tokens swapped through Lunar Finance on the source chain, including meta-aggregator routes (Jupiter, LiFi, 0x, Relay, Orca, etc.) plus Enso batch-sweeper swaps. Data from the Lunar analytics API, filtered per chain and time window.
methodology.Fees: User-paid fees on underlying DEX protocols plus Lunar platform fees where applicable.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees collected by the Lunar Finance treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid to underlying DEX liquidity providers (total fees minus Lunar protocol revenue).

Fees.Aggregator Fees: Aggregator fees paid by users for the swaps.

UserFees.Aggregator Fees: Aggregator fees paid by users for the swaps.

Revenue.Aggregator Fees to Protocol: Part of the aggregator fees that is retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Aggregator Fees to Protocol: Part of the aggregator fees that is retained by the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Aggregator Fees to Liquidity Providers: Part of the aggregator fees that is paid to the liquidity providers.

methodology.BridgeVolume: USD value of assets bridged cross-chain through Lunar Finance, attributed to the source chain. Routes use LiFi, Relay, Hyperlane, Stargate, Mayan, and other bridge providers. Data from the Lunar analytics API (confirmed transactions via lunarfinance.io), filtered per source chain and time window.
methodology.Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees collected by the Lunar Finance treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid to underlying bridge and relayer providers (total fees minus Lunar protocol revenue).

Fees.Bridge Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

UserFees.Bridge Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

Revenue.Bridge Fees to Protocol: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees to Protocol: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees to Providers: Fees paid to underlying bridge and relayer providers.

methodology.Fees: DeltaDeFi Spot Orderbook order execution fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders

methodology.Fees: Fees collected by the Minswap aggregator on routed swaps.
methodology.Revenue: All aggregator fees go to the protocol (100% protocol revenue).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All aggregator fees go to the protocol treasury.
